target_name: Stranded Accrual Investment After Demand Turn
rationale: This is the archived "Demand-Inelastic Working-Capital Accruals" with a one-year lag bolted onto the accrual leg (the LAG device itself borrowed from "Unconverted Accrual Overhang"), a cosmetic timing variant that will mostly attenuate the same accrual-times-distress association rather than test a new mechanism.

The composition base (opaque absorption net of visible receivable/inventory absorption) is a genuinely different construct from the archived "Persistent Opaque Accruals Under Debt," though it is economically ambiguous because it mechanically penalizes firms with large receivable/inventory buildups that the archive's own evidence suggests are themselves bearish.

target_name: Persistent Operating-Cycle Gap in Deficit Firms
rationale: Every component is lifted from the archive — the operating-cycle gap base from "Dual-Deterioration Operating-Cycle Gap," the MA(·,3) persistence wrapper from two prior signals, and the retained-deficit conditioner from "Retained-Deficit Working-Capital Accruals" — making this a plug-and-play recombination rather than a new hypothesis.

This is the literal SUMRANK average of two already-evaluated signals ("Demand-Inelastic Working-Capital Accruals" and "Cash-Runway Erosion Accruals") sharing an identical accrual base, so it can only interpolate between their known results and adds no independent economic content.

The industry-ranked low-depreciation leg and the sales-contraction conditioner are both already in the archive (notably "Demand-Down Depreciation Cut"), and lagging a highly persistent dp/at level by one year is a near-inert transformation that does not create the forward-looking "latent write-down exposure" the reasoning claims.

target_name: Opaque Accrual Surge in Cash Squeeze
rationale: Benchmarking current aoloch absorption against its own trailing average is a distinct base from both the level and persistence versions already tested and pairs coherently with liquidity erosion, though the earlier "Leveraged Accrual Record Breakout" result warns that own-history deviations of a noisy residual line item may be mostly noise.
